title: Polish (Honey Harvest) 抛光（采蜜）
medium: Wood panel, aluminum panel, sandpaper, UV print, kraft paper, oil-based marker, colored tracing paper, nylon mesh, colored pencil, fiber mesh, adhesive tape, museum quality non-reflective acrylic, teak frame 木板、铝板、砂纸、UV印刷、皮纸、油性水彩笔、彩色硫酸纸、尼龙网、彩色铅笔、纤维网、胶带、博物馆级无光有机玻璃、柚木框

said.q: In this series, materials no longer merely serve spatial structures or formal experiments but become direct carriers of subjective experience. The tension between sandpaper's rough surface and the smooth texture achieved through polishing mirrors the inevitable wear and reconstruction involved in self-construction.
